variantPrompts.A:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE final-quality Japanese horizontal HOME promotional banner for air conditioner cleaning, exactly wide 2.75:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2200 x 800. Full bleed artwork, no page chrome, no mockup frame, no letters A/B/C, no annotation. This must feel like a carefully art-directed Japanese retail advertising banner, with expertly crafted advertising lettering and very strong immediate impact, NOT a generic website card or a flat text-on-circle template.
Input images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: borrow their vigorous Japanese advertising typography, clear benefit hierarchy, professional print-ad composition and disciplined pop color. Do not copy any brand, existing copy, date, summer theme, brush gift, telephone number or person. Image 3 is PRODUCT SUBJECT REFERENCE ONLY: two clean white wall-mounted air conditioners. Recompose/render them naturally for this new banner; no human.
Shared composition: clear left approximately 65% text/offer/CTA; right approximately 35% TWO realistic clean white AC units staggered vertically, cool airflow, a few translucent water droplets and star glints. Product visual supports headline rather than outweighing it. Everything aligned optically, custom Japanese lettering, expertly balanced outlines, subtle extrusion/shadow, nuanced margins. Main benefit is huge, smaller copy restrained. No random scattered symbols. One promo ribbon or badge at most. At least 32px safety margins scaled to 2200x800.
CTA must be visually art-directed too: substantial tactile pill button, coherent bevel, subtle highlight and 3D underside, generous padding, precise bold Japanese lettering and a contrasting circular right-arrow icon. More refined than a plain CSS rectangle.
All Japanese text must be spelled correctly and legible. Do NOT add any words beyond the exact specified copy. Footer conditions must be actual legible small Japanese text, not invented glyphs. No logo, watermark, people, limited-period claim, unsupported reassurance.
A direction: strongest promotional benefit. Sunny yellow main field with restrained white sunburst and small halftone accents pushed to edges. Royal cobalt blue right field with a sweeping dynamic boundary, cool cyan airflow behind product. Small top-left cobalt category capsule: "エアコンクリーニング". Hero line "２台まとめて" as spirited, slightly rising heavy Japanese lettering. The overwhelming hero is "4,400円 お得！": giant dimensional cobalt numerals with thick white outline and thin deep navy outer outline, carefully fitted comma and yen; "お得！" in warm orange with white outline, an expressive typographic lockup integrated immediately beside/below the digits. Size contrast, overlapped but readable outline edges and an expertly controlled slight forward tilt like a real advertising art director designed the lettering. No basic Arial digits. Secondary line "１台あたり2,200円お得". Place a superb cobalt pill CTA under hero "料金・サービスを見る" with white circular right arrow. Bottom separate narrow translucent ivory strip: "壁掛けタイプ（お掃除機能なし）／同時に２台以上のご注文時／税込". Keep the entire persuasive flow on left. Polished crisp finish, high visual energy yet cohesive, not cheap busy discount supermarket poster.
